messages_settled_idx.name: messages_settled_idx
messages_settled_idx.where: "messages"."thread_root_id" is null and "messages"."settled_at" is not null

messages_settle_candidates_idx.name: messages_settle_candidates_idx
messages_settle_candidates_idx.where: "messages"."thread_root_id" is null and "messages"."settled_at" is null and "messages"."kept_open_at" is null and "messages"."deleted_at" is null

messages_settled.name: messages_settled
messages_settled.value: ("messages"."settled_at" is null) = ("messages"."settled_how" is null) and ("messages"."settled_how" is null or "messages"."settled_how" in ('person', 'quiet', 'merged', 'resolved'))

tracker_grants_open_idx.name: tracker_grants_open_idx
tracker_grants_open_idx.where: "tracker_grants"."revoked_at" is null and "tracker_grants"."token_sealed" is not null

voice_typing_dutch_agreement.name: voice_typing_dutch_agreement
voice_typing_dutch_agreement.value: NOT "voice_typing"."dutch_voice" OR ("voice_typing"."dutch_voice_agreed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "voice_typing"."dutch_voice_agreed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "voice_typing"."dutch_voice_licence_version" IS NOT NULL)

approvals_execute_at_idx.name: approvals_execute_at_idx
approvals_execute_at_idx.where: "approvals"."execute_at" IS NOT NULL AND "approvals"."executed_at" IS NULL
